A1.justification: Both PDFs describe X-WIN and contain readable, corresponding main sections, equations, five tables, six figures, and references. Neither supplied PDF contains the appendix mentioned in the text; comparison therefore covers all included material, but cannot assess those referenced appendices.

before.justification: V1 reports original classification experiments, ablations, domain-alignment analyses, and CT reconstruction results in Section 4, Tables 1–5, and Figures 3–6.

after.justification: V2 retains these original classification, ablation, domain-alignment, and reconstruction results. Retained results still qualify as original empirical work.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Figure 2 retain the same action-conditioned projection prediction, EMA encoder, affinity-guided contrastive alignment, masked image modeling, and domain adaptation. The architecture, losses, and procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions pretrain on MIMIC-CXR and NLST and evaluate on VinDr, CheXpert, NIH-CXR, RSNA, JSRT, and COVIDx. Projection rendering and CT reconstruction coverage also remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same ten comparison methods. Table 2 retains CheXFound, RAD-DINO, Ark+, and CheXWorld for COVIDx fine-tuning; no comparator is added, removed, or replaced.

E3.justification: The documented model configurations, 512-by-512 inputs, eight sampled projections, training schedule, linear probing, and 4/8/16-shot evaluation remain unchanged. Reconstruction configurations and evaluation metrics also match.

E4.justification: Both retain the same loss-weight and rotation-step analyses, action-design ablation, domain-alignment and anatomical-correspondence analyses, t-SNE visualizations, and reconstruction/codebook study (Tables 3–5 and Figures 3–6). No analytical question or supporting experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Section 4.2 and Table 2 report the same five random seeds for few-shot label sampling and five-run average AUROCs. No repeated-run information or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 and the plotted and qualitative results match. For example, ViT-Large average linear-probing AUROC remains 0.892, COVIDx full-data AUROC remains 0.993, and the best reconstructed-CT PSNR/SSIM remain 27.87 dB/0.789.

T1.justification: The action definition and Equations (1)–(11) retain the same mathematical content. Rendered inspection confirms that extraction differences in the equations do not represent changed definitions, derivations, or losses.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about integrating CT-derived 3D knowledge into CXR world modeling, improving downstream representations, and enabling CT reconstruction. Contribution scope and novelty claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of loss complementarity, action design, domain alignment, and reconstruction blurriness remain unchanged. Section 5 retains the same future-work qualifications concerning domain adaptation and comparisons with models trained directly on CT.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 replaces a future promise to release code and pretrained models with a statement that code is available and a concrete RPIDIAL/X-WIN repository link. V2 no longer explicitly mentions pretrained-model release; other implementation details are unchanged. Repository contents cannot be verified from the PDFs.

R1.justification: The same 55 reference entries and substantive positioning relative to CheXWorld, other world models, and CXR representation learning are retained. Related-work wording corrections do not alter the research positioning.

P1.justification: V2 corrects grammar and typos, standardizes the name X-ray World Intelligence Network, and adds funding acknowledgments before the references. The main narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: The same figures and tables remain in corresponding locations, with minor caption edits and equation-spacing changes. V2 removes printed page numbers, and the added acknowledgments shift the reference layout; no substantive visual redesign occurs.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly improves clarity through proofreading and consistent naming, and improves access documentation by supplying a concrete code link in Section 4.1. Scientific methods and evidence are unchanged. The benefit is limited: repository contents are unverified, pretrained-model access is unspecified, and the referenced appendices remain absent from both supplied PDFs.
